gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-ubuntu-s: Ubuntu Sans reads like bent copper pipe, with big round lowercase eyes and curves that stop before the loop closes. Love Ya Like A Sister is the loud one; the plain sans just talks.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws its line like it was ruled, with wide terminals and a lowercase that fills the line. And Metamorphous is the showier one, its strokes thinning softly toward the ends.
gen-gf-offside-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk has tall-bowled a and e shapes whose terminals never close in, which makes it feel friendly. Schibsted Grotesk against the widely tracked, neon-tube lettering of Offside is the whole appeal: loud on top, welcoming below.
gen-gf-phudu-archivo: Archivo stands tall, with a commanding lowercase and curves that open outward instead of curling back in. Phudu, in a blunt marker-like line, sits lower and rounder beside it.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-asap: Phudu is bold, with openings on every curve. Asap's lowercase nearly reaches the capitals, so a slightly smaller size for the sans-serif body would keep it from crowding the heading.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Loose, rounded and brash: Phudu has a ballpoint's plain line, while Be Vietnam Pro's mean line sits high and its curve endings never nearly touch. That difference in lowercase height is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-epilogue: Round and cheerful, Phudu leads with generous openings on every curve and a pressure-free line. And Epilogue follows with a tall, wire-thin lowercase and stubby ascenders, so long paragraphs feel light and easy going.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-fira-sans: Phudu brings a ballpoint's pressure-free line, with openings on every curve and a moderate lowercase. But Fira Sans is the real strength here, its tall x-height and wide-open s curves giving the plain sans a sturdy footing.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Phudu's lowercase is lower, so a touch more size on the sans body would even them out.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-public-sans: Soft-edged and bold, Phudu opens every curve. Public Sans answers with a hefty lowercase and broad counters, and that jump in lowercase height is the strongest thing about the sans-serif pairing.
